        "name": "When should a black border be used instead of a white border?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "A black border is typically preferred for cinematic photography, monochrome and black-and-white images, moody portraits, and photos taken against light or high-key backgrounds. Black borders reinforce contrast, produce a gallery-like framing effect, and help images stand out in bright social feeds. White borders, by contrast, tend to work better with dark, saturated images and minimalist feeds."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "What is the ideal black border width for Instagram?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "For Instagram, a black border of 20 to 40 pixels on each side generally produces the best balance between visible framing and preserved image area. On a 1080 by 1080 square post, a 30 pixel border is a reliable default. Narrower borders may disappear on smaller devices, while wider borders can shrink the subject inside the frame."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "Do black borders reduce engagement on social media?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "Black borders do not measurably reduce engagement when used deliberately. They can even improve performance for portfolio, fashion, and cinematic content because the added contrast helps images stand out in the feed. Engagement is more strongly influenced by subject matter, timing, and captioning than by border color."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "How can a black border be added to a photo online for free?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "A black border can be added online for free using AdBorder. Upload the image, choose black as the border color, set the desired thickness in pixels or percentage, preview the result in real time, and download the framed image. No account is required and the file is processed locally in the browser."
        }
      },
      {
        "@type": "Question",
        "name": "Should the same black border width be used for print and web?",
        "acceptedAnswer": {
          "@type": "Answer",
          "text": "No. For web and social platforms, border width is best specified in pixels. For print, border width should scale with the physical size of the image, typically 5 to 10 percent of the shortest side. Using a fixed pixel value for print can produce borders that look either too thin at large sizes or overwhelming at small sizes."
        }
      }
